questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I chose Paris to enhance both my medical and language skills. Given that Paris is known for its well-integrated medical practice, I found it highly relevant to my future career as a physician.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I have a critical comment regarding the bureaucratic aspects of the exchange process. I believe the procedures could be structured in a more pedagogical and user-friendly manner, making them easier to navigate and less stressful to manage before, during, and after the mobility period.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I found it a bit difficult to navigate in all the practical informations upon arrival.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Initially, I was required to manage independently. However, upon my arrival at the hospital and the correct department, I was warmly welcomed and received a thorough introduction.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: I initially found it challenging due to my limited French language skills. However, as my proficiency improved during my stay, communication became increasingly easier.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I lived in City Universitaire which was extremely easy to acces. I do truly recommend this housing opportunity to the future residents in Paris.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it is not impossoble and that there is opportunites elsewhere.
